fields.statement: Leaf plan-workflow-applies-rulings is blocked (question ruling-on-serving-draft-node-unappliable). In an autonomous plan run, the arbiter writes its Decision into the run's intention change set, but a finding on a leaf targets a node in the serving draft change set. Neither change set's view holds both nodes, so `rhiza apply` refuses the decided-by link either way (not_found). `rhiza run review-check --rulings` can then never pass for a leaf ruling, so every real plan run with a leaf ruling would end failed. How should this change set resolve it?
